spans.s:
In the द्वन्द compounds of the stars तिष्व and पुनर्वसू , the dual constantly comes in place of the plural.

Terms: समास-द्वन्द

And the words तिष्ठद्गु 'at the time when the cows stand to be milked', etc. are अव्ययीभाव compounds.

Terms: समास-अव्ययीभाव

The Nominative Plural (जस्) of तिस् has acute accent on the last syllable.

Terms: accent-तद्धित

An आर्धधातुक affix beginning with a त may optionally take the इट् affix after the roots 1. इष् 2. सह् 3. लुभ् 4. रुष् and 5. रिष्।

Terms: इट् augment

Short इ is substituted for the penultimate vowel of the Causative अङ्ग (stem) स्था in the Aorist.

Terms: इ substitute
